gates.fact: HMLR INSPIRE Index Polygons current downloadable snapshot was published 2026-07-05
gates.guard: Reject stale snapshot claims not tied to the current published month

gates.fact: HMLR publishes new INSPIRE files on the first Sunday of every month
gates.guard: Do not assume a prior monthly GML remains current after the next scheduled publication

gates.fact: London Borough of Barnet is listed with a downloadable GML in the current HMLR dataset
gates.guard: Block Barnet candidate geometry if the authority GML is unavailable at runtime

gates.fact: London Borough of Enfield is listed with a downloadable GML in the current HMLR dataset
gates.guard: Block Enfield candidate geometry if the authority GML is unavailable at runtime

gates.fact: Current HMLR INSPIRE downloads are supplied under Open Government Licence conditions
gates.guard: Preserve required attribution and licence conditions in published evidence

gates.fact: INSPIRE polygons show position and indicative extent of registered freehold property
gates.guard: Never promote an INSPIRE polygon as exact legal title extent

gates.fact: Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title
gates.guard: Exact INSPIRE ID must be captured from the matched polygon; do not infer it from parcel_ref

gates.fact: A registered title can contain several separate polygons and each polygon has its own INSPIRE ID
gates.guard: Do not collapse multiple polygon identities into one inferred parcel geometry

gates.fact: Registered title extent cannot be established from INSPIRE Index Polygons alone
gates.guard: Keep legal-boundary semantics separate from candidate sampling geometry

gates.fact: HMLR INSPIRE polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid
gates.guard: Do not treat web-map coordinates as canonical sampling coordinates

gates.fact: HMLR technical guidance identifies British National Grid reprojection workflow from EPSG:27700
gates.guard: Require EPSG:27700 geometry before EA/OS sampling

gates.fact: HMLR warns BNG to WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15 metres
gates.guard: Never use reprojected web-map position as exact polygon-match evidence

gates.fact: EA Time Stamped DTM contains site-specific LIDAR surveys across England dating back to 1998
gates.guard: Require survey provenance rather than assuming a single timeless terrain surface
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: EA Time Stamped DTM is available at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on survey
gates.guard: Require the intended 1m-class source for revision-14 primary metric
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: EA DTM removes surface objects from DSM to model terrain surface
gates.guard: Do not substitute DSM/building/vegetation elevations for ground-height metric
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: EA DTM elevations are in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and aligned to OS Grid / EPSG:27700
gates.guard: Reject unknown horizontal or vertical datum before max-minus-min promotion
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: EA states LIDAR vertical accuracy of plus/minus 15cm RMSE
gates.guard: Do not report centimetre-level certainty beyond source accuracy context
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: EA states the transformation used is specific to the survey time period
gates.guard: Require survey/transformation provenance when mixing historical elevation data
gates.source: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

gates.fact: OS Terrain 50 grid is supplied as 10km tiles with 200 pixels per row and 50m by 50m pixels; values represent pixel centres
gates.guard: Use Terrain 50 only as the designated independent coarse crosscheck, not parcel-range source
gates.source: OS Terrain 50 Grid data technical specification

gates.fact: OS Terrain 50 grid heights are given to nearest 0.1m and tile metadata includes flying-date information
gates.guard: Stored 0.1m precision must not be interpreted as 0.1m physical accuracy
gates.source: OS Terrain 50 Grid data technical specification
